remove.title: Remove the {{tag}} set?
remove.description: The set leaves the draft. A single removal cannot be undone: the set comes back only if you discard every change in the draft.
remove.used_one: {{count}} rule refers to this set: sing-box rejects the config until the reference is removed. A single removal cannot be undone, only by discarding every change in the draft.
